title: MySQL keyless table: the update COMPLETED with 2,512,013 of 10,000,000 rows

found.by: expected-entry test round 2026-10-25: MySQL 8.4.13, keyless 10M-row table, one run

symptom: The update COMPLETED with the destination at 2,512,013 of 10,000,000 rows, in a regular gap pattern in each block of 10,000. The gateway had staged all 10,000,000 ids. Two full refreshes kept the same count.
cause: Not isolated. That run had a server max_execution_time set; another run without it reached 10,000,000 on a plain second update.
fix: Count after the SNAPSHOT_COMPLETED event; rerun without the server timeout; record the counts with the gateway's events.
notes: One run for the short count; the 10M reach was a different run.
